newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end moderately firm, upside seen limited.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end moderately firm, upside seen limited.

text.p: UK shares ended a quiet and cautious week with a whimper, despite a robust performance on Wall Street.

The FTSE 100 index closed on Friday up 11.6 points at 4,310.5, for a net gain of just 39.8 points for the week as worries over the strong pound, politics, and interest rates kept many institutional investors on the sidelines.
"I'm glad this week is over. It's been a total waste of time," one senior dealer said. "The trouble is, I can't see things improving. There is just no reason to go into this market at the moment."
